concerns.text: FR-001 (exclude invalid SMILES prior to split) and FR-005 (split cleaned dataset) lack verified implementation tasks. T005 and T006 are marked complete, but T016 (error handling for RDKit failures) and T017 (logging exclusion counts) are unverified. Without T016/T017, the pipeline cannot satisfy the 'exclude before split' and 'log counts' mandates of FR-001/FR-005.

FR-006 (paired t-test) and SC-002 (report statistical power) are unimplementable. T024 (save GNN predictions/metrics) and T025 (calculate RMSE delta) are unverified. T028 (statistical test) requires the prediction artifacts from T024 which are missing. No task covers saving the GNN prediction file required for the t-test.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and FR-001 require logging exclusion counts. T008 (logging infrastructure) and T017 (logging for baseline exclusion counts) are unverified. There is no verified task to produce the 'data/logs' evidence required for invalid SMILES counts.

SC-003 (6-hour pipeline constraint) and FR-004 (CPU-only) cannot be verified. T022 (ensure GNN training completes within 6 hours) is unverified. No task explicitly covers measuring or enforcing the 6-hour runtime constraint on the GNN training script.

SC-001 (measure GNN RMSE against RF baseline) is blocked. T024 (save GNN metrics) and T025 (calculate delta) are unverified. Without the GNN metrics file and delta calculation, the core comparison requirement cannot be fulfilled.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires pinned random seeds. T009 (setup environment configuration for seeds) is unverified. No verified task ensures seeds are pinned in code, violating the reproducibility mandate.

SC-004 (generate PNG > 1KB with non-zero variance) relies on T030 (ensure visualizations saved as PNG), which is unverified. Without this task, the interpretability success criterion cannot be measured.

US-1 Independent Test requires running the pipeline and verifying a model is saved. T014 (implement train_baseline.py) is unverified. The specific script required to run the US-1 test does not have a confirmed artifact.
